bio.text: Mike Simpson represents Idaho's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House and chairs the Interior and Environment Subcommittee on Appropriations.
He was elected to the Blackfoot City Council in 1980 and the Idaho Legislature in 1984, serving there until 1998, the last six years as Speaker.
Born in Burley and raised in Blackfoot, he graduated from Utah State University and earned a dental degree from Washington University in St. Louis, and practiced dentistry with his family.
